kkj6c0vt.baseName: Walplus Plastic Christmas Tree Stand - Black - 46 x 46 x 19 cm
kkj6c0vt.variantName: Walplus Plastic Christmas Tree Stand - Black - 46 x 46 x 19 cm
kkj6c0vt.sourceDescription: Decorate your interior in style this holiday season with this Christmas tree stand. This tree holder provides a stable base for your Christmas tree. The metal frame makes it strong and sturdy. It features 4 strong securing bolts to ensure your tree stays secure. Thanks to the water container, your tree remains fresh and looks great for the whole Christmas season. This tree stand is suitable for a real tree. Product Specifications Colour: Black Material: Metal, plastic Dimensions: 46 x 46 x 19 cm (L x W x H) Max. tree height: 2.1 m Water reservoir capacity: 2 L Suitable for trunk diameter of 50-120 mm Suitable for a real tree Assembly required: Yes This tree stand is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and residential christmas tree support. To prevent severe crush injuries, property damage, or tip-over accidents, always verify that the total weight and height of your live or artificial tree do not exceed the maximum capacities specified by the manufacturer. Place the stand on a flat, solid, and completely level floor surface well away from busy doorways, hallways, or heat sources like radiators and fireplaces. Tighten all steel thumb bolts evenly into the trunk to guarantee perfect structural stability. Regularly check and top up the water reservoir for live trees to prevent drying, which creates a dangerous, rapid fire hazard. This seasonal holiday hardware is not a toy; keep all sharp metal clamping screws, heavy cast-iron bases, water spikes, and plastic retail packaging completely out of reach of children. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingdom.
